q: What does it cost to sell through you?
a: A modest engagement fee to prepare the materials, then a success fee as a percentage of the sale price, paid at completion. No sale, no success fee. We set out fees in writing before you commit.

q: Will my staff, customers or competitors find out?
a: Not from us. Buyers first see an anonymous teaser. Your company name is only released after a signed NDA and your approval, buyer by buyer.

q: Is my business too small for you?
a: We advise on businesses from about S$1m in value, with most work between S$3m and S$30m. If yours is smaller, the valuation tool still gives you a range and a preparation guide.

q: How long does a sale take?
a: Typically six to nine months from mandate to completion. Preparation before going to market is what most affects the timeline and the price.

q: Do I need to stay after the sale?
a: Usually a handover of 6 to 12 months. How long, and on what terms, is negotiated as part of the deal. Low owner dependency shortens it.
